data.raw_text:
This is the handy work of somebody new in the palace.
This is one of his spins using peoples money in the millions.

The Baste-Torre match is:

1. A smoke-screen on the flooding issue and SC Decision declaring the Impeachment of VP is unconstitutional.

2. To Diminish the reputation of Baste.

3. To Insult the Duterte Family.

Facts:

1. Baste filed for Travel Authority last JUNE 2025 (Travel Date: July 25-29)

2. Baste challenged Torre on JULY 19 (Saturday) in his program “Basta Dabawenyo”

3. Travel Authority was approved on July 20, 2025.

4. Torre Accepts challenge on July 24 (Thursday) GAB sanctioned the event even without any agreements from both camps.

5. July 25 (Friday) immediate preparations for the venue started.

6. Baste left for Singapore on July 25 as stated in his Travel Authority.

7. Bout date Torre demanded is July 27 (Sunday)

Now the spin:

1. Torre and his handlers knew that Baste could not be present on July 27 because he filed his Travel Authority from the DILG last June. Hence Torre demanded that date knowing that Baste will not be in the Philippines.

2. The Games and Amusements Board (GAB) sanctions a bout but one of the parties is not informed.  GAB is under the Office of the President.

3. NBI leaked the information of Baste’s departure for unknown reasons. 

4. DILG knows of the TA and Departure weeks ahead. DILG has the approved copy of the TA last July 20. Torre reports to the DILG.

4. If Torre agreed to the challenge, why was Baste not informed? Why was the preparations so swift? Got a venue and other arrangements within 24 hours? 

So, who is the real coward now? If  you’ll accept a challenge and made your own instant preparations, set your own date and time + not telling your opponent and clearly knows that he cannot be there, then you just accepted the challenge without any intent of really going through it 😊😊😊
_Dē Zām

🇵🇭 Mr. President, the Nation Needs More Than Promises

As you stand before the Filipino people in your 2025 State of the Nation Address, we humbly ask you to confront the urgent truths that define our daily lives.

PhilHealth has been defunded. This is not just a fiscal decision—it is a humanitarian crisis. Millions of Filipinos now face illness without support, and the zero allocation in the 2025 budget sends a chilling message to every family struggling to access care.

We call on the Supreme Court to release its ruling on the PhilHealth Fund Transfer case. We also urge the Court to decide on the petition against the zero budget allocation. These decisions will profoundly shape the 2026 budget deliberations and set a precedent for transparency and accountability in fiscal governance.

Education gaps are widening. Our youth deserve more than rhetoric—they deserve classrooms, teachers, and a future.

Fiscal deficits are deepening. But the solution is not austerity—it is courage. We call on your administration to rebuild fiscal space by raising health taxes, especially through higher excise taxes on sin products. These revenues must be earmarked for nutrition programs, preventive care, and universal health coverage.

And most urgently, flood control projects are paralyzing the economy and disrupting lives. From Metro Manila to the provinces, daily flooding is not just an inconvenience—it is a failure of planning, coordination, and political will.

Mr. President, this is your moment to lead with integrity. 

To choose action over applause. 

To restore trust in public institutions and deliver on the promise of a government that truly serves its people.

Let this SONA be remembered not for what was said—but for what was done.

#HealthWithHonor 
#RelentlessForChange 

Tony Leachon
